_comment: The Leaf Cafe Bistro — 124 Boroughbridge Road, Acomb, York. Trading name taken from the shop's own logo artwork: THE LEAF / CAFÉ & BISTRO. The printed menu header sets it as CAFE - BISTRO with a dot, but the logo is the brand mark and it carries the accent and the ampersand. The design handoff had dropped the "The" when it generated the logo — see _comment_logo. Landing page ported from the supplied design handoff (leaf-cafe-bistro-build-kit). The shop is PRE-LAUNCH: see the prelaunch flag at the bottom, and the UNCONFIRMED list below.
_comment_unconfirmed: STILL NEEDED BEFORE LAUNCH: (1) legal name + company number; (2) the Stripe Connect acct_ id and the delivery areas and fees — both being done at the Z93 install; (3) seo.geo latitude/longitude for YO26 6AB, which must be looked up rather than guessed. Address, postcode, phone, orders email, opening hours and the menu are all CONFIRMED.
_comment_ordering: DECIDED: Leaf is ONLINE ORDERS ONLY — no table booking — and does BOTH delivery and collection. The supplied design was a booking shape ('Book a table', 'View menu' links that went nowhere); the landing page has been reworked so every call to action lands on /order.
_comment_menu: REAL MENU — 92 items across 20 categories, transcribed from the shop's printed two-page menu. Do not hand-edit menu.json or menu-visual.json: both are GENERATED by tools/_gen-leaf-menu.py from one table, so a price is written once in pounds and the pence value is derived. Edit that script and re-run it. Category order is deliberately not the printed order — the printed sheet is laid out in columns for two physical pages; this is ordered for someone ordering online (meals, then sides, kids, desserts, drinks last).

business._comment_shortName: Conversational short form used in page headers, aria labels and the staff PWA name.
business._comment_contact: Both of these PRINT on the customer-facing pages. The landing page deliberately does not render a phone number anywhere (the design doesn't have one), so a placeholder here is not visible on the landing page itself — but it is on the shared order/terms pages.

_comment_logo: Brand assets are GENERATED by tools/_gen-leaf-brand.py from the shop's own artwork at _source/logo-master.png. It writes logo.png (header, footer, receipt emails), icon.png (favicon, /favicon.ico, staff app) and assets/og-image.jpg (the share card). Do not hand-edit those three. The favicon is the LEAF GLYPH lifted out of the A of LEAF, not the wordmark — a wordmark at 32px is an illegible smear. It lifts cleanly because the artwork is gold-on-transparency, so the leaf is its own connected component in the alpha channel and no rectangular crop drags in the A. Note the logo gold is #F0BF4D, brighter than theme.accent #C39B52 from the design handoff; the two sit side by side in the header and read fine, artwork against UI, but that is the reason they differ.
_comment_theme: Straight from the design handoff's stated palette: forest green #153B31, dark green #102D25, muted gold #C39B52, pale gold #D5B573, warm ivory #F0EADF, oatmeal #EBE2D2. primaryDeep is the only value not in that list — darkened from #102D25 for the footer.

fulfillment._comment_delivery: ON — the owner has confirmed Leaf does delivery as well as collection. ⚠️ THE AREAS AND FEES BELOW ARE NOT CONFIRMED. They are a starting point only, shaped on Leaf sitting on Boroughbridge Road in the same part of York as Mega Chippy (Gale Lane): the YO24/YO26/YO23 outcodes nearest the shop, one flat fee, a 3-mile cap. EVERY ONE OF THESE NUMBERS MUST COME FROM THE OWNER BEFORE LAUNCH — a wrong fee is charged on every single delivery order, and a wrong outcode either turns away a street the shop serves or commits it to one it does not. If Leaf prices by distance rather than postcode, switch mode to 'radius' and use bands instead (see data/shops/_template/config.json).

delivery._comment_maxMiles: Road-distance cap layered on top of the outcode list, so an outcode that sprawls past the round cannot be ordered from. roadFactor scales straight-line distance to approximate a driven route.

_comment_serviceFee: Per-order platform fee in pence. Charged to the customer and kept by the platform.
_comment_hours: CONFIRMED BY THE OWNER, 17 Sep 2026. Open 08:00-17:00 every day except TUESDAY, which is closed. These replace the invented placeholder that was scaffolded with the shop. 24-hour format; a close after midnight would be written as 25:00 = 01:00 next day. NOTE: closing at 17:00 every day means the shop does NOT trade in the evening - see _comment_evening_copy.
_comment_evening_copy: RESOLVED. The shop closes at 17:00, so the three evening references written against the placeholder hours have all gone: the 'Evening / Relaxed dining' menu card was removed on the owner's instruction, and with that as the signal the hero's 'comforting evening plates' became 'comforting plates all day' and seo.description's 'bistro evenings' became 'proper coffee'. Restore all three together if evening service is ever added.

ordering._comment_businessDayStartHour: 4 = the trading day runs 4am-to-4am. Safe for a daytime shop; nothing trades in the 0–4am window to reclassify.

_comment_pos: Deliberately NOT hospitality. Leaf is a sit-in cafe, but its device is a LumiWEB Z93 running orders-only: no counter sales, no eat-in mode, just the order board. serviceStyle only shapes the counter EPOS sale modes, which ordersOnly hides outright, so it would have no effect. If Leaf ever moves up to a full LumiPOS till, revisit this AND add real pos.tables — inventing table numbers would print fictional tables on kitchen tickets.
_comment_pos_product: LumiWEB shop (ZCS Z93, website-only). ordersOnly:true hides the counter EPOS mode bar and the card-reader tile, so a shop paying for a website does not get an EPOS it has not bought, and staff do not get counter buttons on a device with no cash drawer. Per docs/PRODUCTS.md this is the ONLY thing distinguishing LumiPOS from LumiWEB in software.

allergens.noticeAtCheckout: For allergens please contact the café before ordering.

_comment_prelaunch: KEEPS THE SHOP OUT OF GOOGLE. Every page sends X-Robots-Tag: noindex and robots.txt is Disallow-all. REMOVE THIS LINE ON LAUNCH DAY or the site stays invisible.

seo._comment_description: The line Google shows under the result, written for a person. Leads with the brand name plus Acomb because that adjacency is what a local search matches on.
seo.description: The Leaf Café & Bistro — an independent café and bistro on Boroughbridge Road, Acomb, York. Breakfasts, relaxed lunches and proper coffee. Order online for delivery or collection in Acomb and York.
seo._comment_ogImage: The picture shown when the link is shared. Supplied in the design handoff as a 1200x630 card built from the real interior photo and the gold wordmark.
seo._comment_geo: STILL MISSING. The postcode is now known (YO26 6AB) but api.postcodes.io is blocked from the build environment, and these must not be guessed — they place the pin on Google. Look YO26 6AB up and paste the real latitude/longitude here.
seo._comment_sameAs: MISSING. Add Leaf's Facebook / Instagram / Google Business profile URLs once known.
